decision_basis: Official source, checksum-verified, deep history, proven quality/PIT/fingerprint behavior on a 7-day engineering sample. Limitation is cost of full backfill, not quality.

DATA_AUTHORITY.evidence: official data.binance.vision archive; official .CHECKSUM sha256 sidecars verified on all 21 sample files; tooling MIT license separated from Binance data terms

HISTORICAL_DEPTH.evidence: daily archive BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT from 2019-12-31, SOLUSDT from 2020-09-14 through 2026-09-10; 0 missing files first-to-last (DATA_ARCHIVE_COVERAGE_MATRIX.json)

PIT_SAFETY.evidence: event-time (transact_time) UTC ms; immutable archives; data_time <= decision cutoff enforced and tested (future-mutation tests PASS)

QUALITY.evidence: 16,269,514 rows normalized, 0 quality errors, 0 duplicate agg_trade_ids, monotonic after canonical sort, price/quantity invariants hold

INFORMATION_DISTINCTNESS.evidence: event-level direction (buyer_is_maker -> taker side), per-trade size, burst structure and intra-bar sequence are not derivable from hourly OHLCV / takerBuyBaseVolume / funding / regime state (Track J, data-level only)

COST.evidence: full 3-symbol backfill ~101 GB compressed / ~455 GB uncompressed, ~6,700 files (Track D1)

STORAGE.evidence: same as COST; 7-day sample = 186 MB compressed / ~840 MB uncompressed

PORTABILITY.evidence: plain zip+CSV with sha256 sidecars; no proprietary tooling required

limitations: FULL_BACKFILL = COST_REVIEW_REQUIRED (~101 GB compressed, 3 symbols); not required for this checkpoint
sample window (2026-09-01..07) is engineering validation only, NOT alpha evidence (Track I)
direction_semantics_authority: Official USD-M aggTrades schema: is_buyer_maker=true => buyer is maker => taker side is SELL; false => taker side is BUY. Documented in data_contracts.py and validated by tests.
